marketRotation.policy: each difficulty receives each of five markets once per five-game block; market offset advances by one per game

difficultyRotation.policy: one easy, normal, and hard AI in every game; fixed seat/pawn per difficulty

catalog.classification: active company capCategory; fallback thresholds <40B small, <200B medium, otherwise large

method.enginePath: createGame -> getDecisionPlayerId -> chooseAiCommand -> executeCommand until engine finished
method.individualTurnDefinition: per-fund count of executed NEXT_TURN commands; first purchase is attributed to the current upcoming personal turn
method.firstPurchaseDefinition: first BUY_SHARE command per fund, classified by company capCategory at action time
method.checkpointDefinition: snapshot after the final solvent fund completes the named cycle; captures omitted if game ends earlier
method.smallPortfolioDefinition: number of small companies with positive holdings and total small-category shares; averages reported for all and solvent funds
method.opportunityDefinition: at one market-phase check per personal turn, companies available, below 5 total shares, not E/E, affordable for one share; raw cash and difficulty reserve variants, including one-unit travel cost for other zones
method.bankruptcyDefinition: count of company available true-to-false transitions during completed games
method.waiting100Definition: 100 consecutive personal NEXT_TURNs after cycle 10 without BUY_SHARE; each nonattaining completed-game observation is reported as right-censored at end

waiting100WithoutPurchaseAfterCycle10.note: The active game horizon may end before 100 personal turns after cycle 10; these cases remain censored rather than treated as completed 100-turn waits.
